page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r9i.8xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing Intel Xeon 6982P-C processors running at a clock speed of 3.2 GHz. The instance is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high resource density of 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

This instance configuration does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external block storage volumes. It does not feature any integrated graphics processing units (GPUs). For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps, supporting steady data transfer rates for distributed environments.

Given the 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the ecs.r9i.8xlarge offers a resource profile tailored for memory-intensive applications. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and high memory density make it suitable for workloads where memory capacity is the primary bottleneck, avoiding the need to over-provision compute resources. Appropriate workloads include in-memory databases, large-scale caching layers, enterprise resource planning systems, and memory-bound data processing tasks.
